## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rome, Italy. It starts at Largo Sant'Angelo 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> If you've stared at old Romantic paintings and wished you could step inside them, head to Parco Villa Gregoriana for the next best thing. Enjoy spectacular nature just a stone's throw from Rome. Hike easy trails, explore unique woodlands littered with ancient ruins, and peek into natural caves. All this in a park commissioned by Pope Gregory XVI in the early 19th century!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.88. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 157 ratings and 82 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
